title: Rust ownership is part of the tensor contract
purpose: The owner contains its buffer. Immutable and exclusive views borrow that buffer and own their metadata.
contract: Filled diamond: composition; dashed dependency: borrowed element storage
Each view owns shape/stride metadata; only TensorView has a base offset
Shared and exclusive views shown as alternatives; overlapping live access is forbidden
